name: @team-harness/threadshare
description: Self-hostable API, viewer, and CLI for sharing AI agent conversation threads

scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:fc: npm run build:fc && (cd fc && licell deploy)
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler dev --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test:fc: npm run build:fc && node --test test/cloudflare-routing.test.mjs fc/handler.test.cjs
scripts.test:cli: node --test test/agent-transcript.test.mjs test/cli.test.mjs test/history-selection.test.mjs test/insights-agent-spec.test.mjs test/insights-mcp.test.mjs test/insights-query-schema.test.mjs test/insights-query.test.mjs test/insights-reference-engine.test.mjs test/memory-contracts.test.mjs test/memory-extraction.test.mjs test/memory-format.test.mjs test/memory-insights-source.test.mjs test/memory-lint.test.mjs test/memory-repository.test.mjs test/memory-runner.test.mjs test/paseo-session-bridge.test.mjs test/session-evidence.test.mjs test/session-facts-golden.test.mjs test/session-listing.test.mjs test/share-preflight.test.mjs test/share-read.test.mjs test/turn-analysis.test.mjs
